modules.module_title: Carry out wet cupping therapy procedure

pcs.pc_description: position the patient appropriately for the wet cupping therapy procedure
clean the desired area with antiseptic solution
perform mild massage and mild fomentation before proceeding to the main procedure.

ensure that aseptic techniques are used like using disposable surgical gloves, sterile cotton, bed rolls, disposable plastic cups, disposable surgical blades, surgical gown, and mask are used for all the processes
perform incision with a firm, skilled hand, should make incision on the skin, avoiding damage to the major vessels, nerves, vital structures
ensure that special care should be taken for cardiac, respiratory, vascular disorders before performing wet cupping
make appropriate adjustments during procedure to meet any changing needs
respect patients’ boundaries at all times
seek patient feedback on comfort levels
check the patient well-being throughout and give reassurance wherever needed
seek help and support from other colleagues in case needed on emergency
apply the cups on the treatment area with the help of suction gun
observe any unusual observations during the procedure such as discomfort to the patient etc
follow 4 step procedure of wet cupping as per guidelines.
manage immediately in case of complications arising after the procedure such as fainting, uncontrolled bleeding, deviations in the vital signs or any other adverse reaction
perform dressing in the area if any blisters have appeared
clean the Cupped area with antiseptic liquid after the treatment
discard the consumables like gauze pieces, needles according to the waste management protocols
guide the patient about specific post- procedure precautions such as strict adherence to diet plan, activities, Precautions and not to take bath upto 24 hours
inform the patient about the next follow- up schedule
complete and maintain records in accordance with professional and legal requirements
